segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe the balm as nourishing and hydrating, including one who calls it ideal for very dry skin because it leaves a protective film, though she personally prefers not to feel that film on her face.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including a reviewer's daughter, report no irritation or breakouts, but one reviewer says her skin was too sensitive for it and it made her face burn on two separate attempts.
segments.combination: The one reviewer with combination skin reports it worked well removing her makeup and left her skin smooth into the next day.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers dealing with dryness or dehydration consistently describe the balm as leaving skin soft and hydrated rather than tight, including one who used it to rescue severely dehydrated skin on a long flight and could skip moisturizer afterward; a few reviewers, however, found it too rich, saying it leaves a film that never fully rinses off without a second cleanser.
concerns.redness: One reviewer notes that, unlike most cleansers she has tried, this one did not leave her skin red, while another reports mild redness after use, which she says is typical for her whenever she uses any balm cleanser.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits the balm with replenishing her skin barrier while removing makeup in a single step.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers consistently report no new breakouts from using the balm, including one who specifies no reactions beyond her normal hormonal acne.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Really have enjoyed this cleansing balm! It melts easily over the skin to break up makeup & more, then becomes milky when water is added, becoming a great cleanser. When using around my eyes to remove eye makeup, I do not feel any stinging or burning & i don't experience a film-like blurriness after washing it away from my eyes (hard to explain in words but some other cleansing balms after being washed away make it seem like there's a film over my eyes & I have a hard time seeing). My skin feels soft & hydrated before I apply my serums & moisturizer, too. I haven't experienced any adverse reactions like breakouts (outside of normal hormonal acne), rashes or itchiness, and find it very gentle. The container is amazing & innovative. I love that you just twist the bottom & out of the top the balm comes out, so you can control how much you need & can keep the container from being contaminated - no need to dig your fingers in or rely on a separate spatula to get the product out. I recommend this cleansing balm!
